The callback function CanTSyn_TxConfirmation shall inform the Det , if development error detection is enabled ( CanTSynDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE) and if the function call has failed because of the following reason: • Invalid PDU ID (CANTSYN_E_INVALID_PDUID), i.e., a PDU ID not configured by parameter CanTSynGlobalTimeMasterConfirmationHandleId
